title: Funny
subtitle: funny = 有趣的；好笑的；幽默的；令人發笑的
description: funny = 有趣的；好笑的；幽默的；令人發笑的

words.note: 較中性、常見，適合形容故事、評論、文章、演講或情境帶有幽默成分。
words.example: The speaker gave a humorous account of his first day at work.

exercises.original: The speaker gave a funny account of his first day at work.
exercises.zh: 講者以幽默方式講述自己第一天上班的經歷。
exercises.upgrade: humorous · 幽默的；詼諧的

options.explanation: — humorous account 很自然，表示敘述帶幽默成分。

exercises.original: The article takes a funny look at everyday office problems.
exercises.zh: 文章以幽默角度看日常辦公室問題。
exercises.upgrade: humorous · 幽默的；詼諧的

options.explanation: — a humorous look at... 是自然搭配。
— 會變成帶批評性的諷刺角度。

exercises.original: The teacher used a funny example to explain the grammar point.
exercises.zh: 老師用一個幽默例子解釋這個文法重點。
exercises.upgrade: humorous · 幽默的；詼諧的

options.explanation: — 帶笑點的例子令解釋更輕鬆。
— 不必要地加入諷刺意味。

words.meaning: 有趣好笑的；逗人發笑的
words.note: 強調某件事令人覺得輕鬆、有趣或想笑，笑感通常比 hilarious 弱。
words.example: We found his description of the mistake amusing.

exercises.original: We found his description of the mistake funny.
exercises.zh: 我們覺得他對那次錯誤的描述頗有趣好笑。
exercises.upgrade: amusing · 有趣好笑的；逗人發笑的

options.explanation: — find + object + amusing 是自然結構。
— 描述表達方式，不是聽者反應。

exercises.original: The children thought the puppet's voice was funny.
exercises.zh: 孩子們覺得木偶的聲音很有趣好笑。
exercises.upgrade: amusing · 有趣好笑的；逗人發笑的

options.explanation: — amusing 描述「令人覺得好笑」的事物。
— 形容感到好笑的人，不是 voice。

exercises.original: There was something funny about the way the cat kept opening the cupboard.
exercises.zh: 那隻貓不停打開櫃門的方式有點令人發笑。
exercises.upgrade: amusing · 有趣好笑的；逗人發笑的

options.explanation: — 行為令人覺得輕鬆好笑。
— 常帶「荒謬得可笑」的負面評價。

words.meaning: 滑稽的；像喜劇般好笑的
words.note: 常形容動作、外表、情況或錯誤帶有誇張、滑稽、喜劇式效果。
words.example: The dog made a comical attempt to climb onto the chair.

exercises.original: The dog made a funny attempt to climb onto the chair.
exercises.zh: 那隻狗試圖爬上椅子的樣子十分滑稽。
exercises.upgrade: comical · 滑稽的；像喜劇般好笑的

options.explanation: — 動作像喜劇場面一樣滑稽。
— 主要指聰明言語，不適合動作。

exercises.original: His oversized hat gave him a funny appearance.
exercises.zh: 他那頂過大的帽令他的外表顯得很滑稽。
exercises.upgrade: comical · 滑稽的；像喜劇般好笑的

options.explanation: — 誇張外表產生喜劇效果。
— 有娛樂性，但不等於外表滑稽。

exercises.original: The misunderstanding led to a funny scene in which everyone entered the wrong room.
exercises.zh: 這場誤會造成一個滑稽場面，所有人都走錯了房間。
exercises.upgrade: comical · 滑稽的；像喜劇般好笑的

options.explanation: — 誤會造成像喜劇橋段般的場面。

words.meaning: 非常好笑的；令人捧腹的
words.note: 比 funny 強很多，表示令人笑得很厲害。
words.example: The final scene was absolutely hilarious.

exercises.original: The final scene was so funny that the whole audience burst out laughing.
exercises.zh: 最後一幕非常好笑，全場觀眾都突然大笑起來。
exercises.upgrade: hilarious · 非常好笑的；令人捧腹的

options.explanation: — burst out laughing 表示笑感很強。

exercises.original: Everyone agreed that the comedian's story was extremely funny.
exercises.zh: 大家都認為那名喜劇演員的故事非常好笑。
exercises.upgrade: hilarious · 非常好笑的；令人捧腹的

options.explanation: — extremely funny 直接對應 hilarious。

exercises.original: The video was so funny that I watched it three times and laughed every time.
exercises.zh: 那段影片非常好笑，我看了三次，每次都笑。
exercises.upgrade: hilarious · 非常好笑的；令人捧腹的

options.explanation: — 反覆觀看仍然大笑，表示笑感很強。

words.meaning: 機智幽默的；妙語連珠的
words.note: 強調幽默來自聰明、快速或巧妙的用字，常形容 remarks、comments、dialogue 或人。
words.example: Her witty comments kept the audience entertained.

exercises.original: Her funny comments showed how quickly she could think of clever replies.
exercises.zh: 她幽默的評論顯示她很快便能想到機智回答。
exercises.upgrade: witty · 機智幽默的；妙語連珠的

options.explanation: — clever replies 明確指機智型幽默。
— 可尖銳，但不一定機智好笑。

exercises.original: The script is full of funny dialogue and clever wordplay.
exercises.zh: 劇本充滿機智幽默的對白和巧妙文字遊戲。
exercises.upgrade: witty · 機智幽默的；妙語連珠的

options.explanation: — 可滑稽，但未必靠語言機智。
— 輕鬆玩味，但不必然幽默機智。

exercises.original: The host was funny in a clever, quick way rather than simply acting silly.
exercises.zh: 主持人的幽默來自聰明和反應快，而不是單純扮傻。
exercises.upgrade: witty · 機智幽默的；妙語連珠的

options.explanation: — clever, quick 明確指出機智。
— 滑稽效果，不一定來自語言。

words.note: 較常放在名詞前，表示某場面、效果、角色或元素具有喜劇性。
words.example: The misunderstanding created a comic situation.

exercises.original: The misunderstanding created a funny situation.
exercises.zh: 這場誤會造成了一個滑稽場面。
exercises.upgrade: comic · 滑稽的；喜劇性的

exercises.original: The actor's exaggerated walk added a funny effect to the scene.
exercises.zh: 演員誇張的走路方式為場面增添了喜劇效果。
exercises.upgrade: comic · 滑稽的；喜劇性的

options.explanation: — comic effect 是自然固定搭配。

exercises.original: The director included several funny moments to make the serious story feel lighter.
exercises.zh: 導演加入數個滑稽片段，令嚴肅故事感覺輕鬆一點。
exercises.upgrade: comic · 滑稽的；喜劇性的

options.explanation: — comic moments 指作品中的喜劇片段。

words.note: 較口語、力度很強，表示某事非常好笑，誇張地說令人「笑到肚痛」。
words.example: His story about the disastrous dinner was side-splitting.

exercises.original: His story about the disastrous dinner was extremely funny and had everyone laughing nonstop.
exercises.zh: 他講那頓災難性晚餐的故事極之好笑，令所有人笑個不停。
exercises.upgrade: side-splitting · 極好笑的；笑到肚痛的

options.explanation: — laughing nonstop 表示極高強度的笑感。

exercises.original: The comedian's routine was so funny that people were wiping tears from their eyes.
exercises.zh: 那名喜劇演員的表演太好笑，觀眾笑到要抹眼淚。
exercises.upgrade: side-splitting · 極好笑的；笑到肚痛的

options.explanation: — 笑到流眼淚表示強烈喜劇效果。

exercises.original: The performance was incredibly funny, and the audience could hardly stop laughing.
exercises.zh: 表演好笑得不得了，觀眾幾乎停不了笑。
exercises.upgrade: side-splitting · 極好笑的；笑到肚痛的

options.explanation: — could hardly stop laughing 對應極度好笑。
— 輕鬆玩味，不一定令人爆笑。
— 強調聰明用字，不適合概括整場表演。
— 副詞，was 後需要形容詞。 End of teaching material

falseSynonyms.zh: 奇怪的不等於好笑 strange 表示奇怪；雖然 funny 有時也可表示 strange，但本課的 funny 是「令人發笑」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON That smell is strange, but there is nothing humorous about it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有娛樂性不等於一定好笑 entertaining 表示有趣、能吸引人，可以是刺激、感人或精彩，不一定令人發笑。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A documentary can be entertaining without being funny.

falseSynonyms.zh: 傻氣不等於幽默 silly 表示愚蠢、孩子氣或不嚴肅；有時可以令人發笑，但不一定。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A silly mistake may be embarrassing rather than amusing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 諷刺不等於幽默 sarcastic 通常透過反話或尖銳語氣批評人；有時會好笑，但也可能傷人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A sarcastic remark may sound clever without being friendly or funny.

falseSynonyms.zh: 荒謬不等於單純好笑 ridiculous 表示荒唐、不合理；有時因荒謬而令人發笑，但核心意思不是幽默。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The proposal was ridiculous, but nobody found it amusing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可笑不等於輕鬆幽默 laughable 常表示某事差得、荒謬得令人恥笑，帶負面評價，不等於一般 funny。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The excuse was laughable because nobody believed it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 好笑和有樂趣不同 funny = 令人發笑；fun = 有樂趣、好玩。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The game was fun, and the host was funny.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞和形容詞不同 humour 是「幽默」這個名詞；humorous 是「幽默的」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The speech contained a lot of humour. It was a humorous speech.
